en.text:
Weapons of Light from <void/>Ward of Dawn can now persist outside the bubble for 15 seconds.

While Weapons of Light is active: 
Gain stacks of 'The Saint' by dealing damage or scoring kills against enemies. Maximum of 14 stacks. Stack duration is equal to the remaining duration of your currently active <void/>Ward of Dawn.

Stacks granted by kill are based off <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />, with Minor|Elite|Miniboss Tier enemies granting 1|2|3 stacks. Stacks granted by hit are granted after dealing an average of ~500-700 damage, with higher damage instances requiring at minimum 2 hits. Hit requirement stays the same across all difficulties (ignores power-deltas).

Gaining a stack of 'The Saint' through <kinetic/>Kinetic or <void/>Void damage triggers a <void/>Suppressing Blast in a 6? meter radius around the target, applying <void/>Suppression for <pve 6 /> <pvp [?] /> seconds. 

Picking up your <void/>Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint and extends its active timer by ? seconds per stack consumed. Maximum of two extensions per super.
